title: EdgeStation widget manifest
description: The manifest.json of an EdgeStation widget. The widget's id is its folder name.

description.description: What the widget shows, for Settings.

minAppVersion.description: Oldest EdgeStation version the widget runs on, such as "0.1.0": the one whose api it uses. Older versions show the error card instead.

main.description: Entry ES module, relative to the widget folder. It default-exports { mount(el, api) }.

styles.description: Stylesheet loaded into the widget's shadow root, relative to the widget folder.

icon.description: Square SVG or PNG on a transparent background, shown in Settings. Only its shape counts: it is drawn in the accent color.

size.description: Default size in grid cells when the widget is added to a page.

permissions.description: The parts of api the widget uses. The marketplace shows what each one allows before an install. A call to a part not listed here shows the error card. system also gives api.topPrograms. webview also gives the widget's settings a Profile choice.

settings.description: Options the user sets per placement, in display order. The widget reads them from api.settings.

key.description: Name of the value in api.settings.

value.description: A value of the named setting, or a list that matches any of its values.

when.description: Only show this setting while the named settings have these values. A list matches any of its values.

unless.description: Hide this setting while the named settings have these values. A list matches any of its values.

select.description: One value out of a list.

source.description: Adds the choices of a list EdgeStation reads when the settings show, after options. audioApps: the apps with sound, saved as their executable's file name. A saved value missing from the list stays saved.

default.description: Value until the user picks one. Defaults to the first option.

text.description: Free text, such as a URL.

default.description: Value until the user types one.

placeholder.description: Hint shown while the field is empty.

secret.description: Hides the value in the settings, as in a password field. It is still saved as plain text.
